title: Retail Installment Contracts Borrower Terms: Offset for Fees on a Failed Payment
content:
When a payment on a contract under Retail Installment Contracts is returned unpaid, an amount is taken from the returned-payment fee according to how the returned payment was made:

1. **Payment taken by a representative.** When the returned payment was a one-time payment taken by a live representative — by bank draft or by debit card — and an agent-assisted payment fee was charged on it, waived or not, that agent-assisted fee is taken from the returned-payment fee.
2. **Recurring autopay draft.** When the returned payment was a recurring autopay draft, **5.00** is taken from the returned-payment fee.
3. Otherwise nothing is taken.

| Original channel of the returned payment | Agent-assisted fee on that payment | Amount taken from the fee |
|---|---|---|
| bank draft or debit card through a live representative | charged (waived or not) | the amount of that agent-assisted fee |
| bank draft or debit card through a live representative | none charged | nothing |
| recurring autopay draft | — | 5.00 |
| self-service draft or card, mailed check, MoneyGram, wire, certified funds, third-party remittance | — | nothing |

The agent-assisted fee read is the one linked to the returned payment itself.

**Hypothetical cases.** A one-time debit-card payment taken by a representative carried a 7.95 agent-assisted fee that was later waived; it was charged on the payment, so 7.95 is taken. A payment taken by a representative in an exempt state carried no agent-assisted fee, so nothing is taken.
